extDescription.message: Generate passwords, passphrases, API keys and secrets locally with an auditable CSPRNG core. No network access.
extDescription.description: Store and manifest description. At most 132 characters.

languageTag.description: BCP 47 tag of the language this file is written in. Not shown: it sets the lang attribute of the popup and the number format.

menuFillPassword.description: Context menu item on editable fields.

commandFillPassword.message: Generate a password and fill the focused password field
commandFillPassword.description: Keyboard shortcut description in the browser's shortcut settings.

fillOk.description: A generated value was written to the focused field.

fillOkConfirm.message: Filled the field and its confirmation field.
fillOkConfirm.description: A generated password was written to the focused field and to the confirm-password field.

fillOkShortened.message: Filled a $LENGTH$-character password, the most this field accepts.
fillOkShortened.description: The password was shortened to the field's maxlength and filled.

fillModified.message: Filled, but the page changed the value. Check the field before saving.
fillModified.description: The page reformatted or stripped the value after it was filled.

fillTooLong.message: This field accepts at most $MAX$ characters. Generate a shorter value in the popup.
fillTooLong.description: The generated value is longer than the field's maxlength.

fillCrossOrigin.message: The field is inside a frame from another site, which the extension cannot reach. Use Copy and paste instead.
fillCrossOrigin.description: Focus is inside a cross-origin iframe.

fillBlocked.message: The browser does not allow filling on this page or inside this frame. Use Copy and paste instead.
fillBlocked.description: Script injection was refused: browser page, store page, PDF viewer or a cross-origin frame.

fillNotPassword.message: The shortcut only fills password fields. Focus a password field, or right-click the field instead.
fillNotPassword.description: The keyboard shortcut was used while a non-password field was focused.

fillReadOnly.description: The focused field is disabled or read-only.

fillHidden.message: The focused field is not visible, so nothing was filled.

fillNoField.message: Click a text or password field on the page first.

fillGenerateFailed.message: Could not generate a password with the current settings: $REASON$
fillGenerateFailed.description: The generator refused the saved password settings. REASON is the core's English error text.

popupTabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the popup's tab list.

popupTabPassword.description: Tab: random password. Keep the six tab labels short: they share one 360px row.

popupTabPassphrase.description: Tab: passphrase made of dictionary words. Keep it short (see popupTabPassword).

popupTabSecret.description: Tab: random bytes encoded as text, for tokens and keys. Keep it short (see popupTabPassword).

popupTabApiKey.description: Tab: API key with a prefix. Keep it short (see popupTabPassword).

popupTabPin.description: Tab: numeric PIN. Keep it short (see popupTabPassword).

popupTabEntropy.description: Tab: estimate the entropy of a password the user types. Keep it short (see popupTabPassword).

popupOutputLabel.description: Accessible name of the box that shows the generated value.

popupRegenerate.description: Button: generate a new value with the same options.

popupCopy.description: Button: copy the generated value to the clipboard.

popupFill.description: Button: write the generated value into the field that has focus on the page.

popupCopied.description: Status after the value was copied to the clipboard.

popupCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the value and copy it manually.
popupCopyFailed.description: Status when the browser refused the clipboard write.

popupNoValue.description: Tooltip of the disabled Copy and Fill buttons while nothing has been generated.

popupFillUnavailable.message: Fill is not available on this page. Use Copy.
popupFillUnavailable.description: Hint and tooltip when the active tab is a page extensions cannot script (browser pages, extension stores).

popupFillInsecure.message: Warning: this page does not use HTTPS.
popupFillInsecure.description: Appended to the fill status when the page was loaded over plain HTTP.

popupSaveFailed.description: Status when writing the options to extension storage failed.

popupEntropy.description: Entropy of the value. BITS is a number with one decimal.

popupLengthOne.description: Length of a value that is exactly one character long.

popupLengthMany.description: Length of the value. COUNT is never 1.

popupCrackLabel.description: Label before an estimated brute-force time such as '3 years'. It is also the summary of a collapsible list with the estimates for weaker attackers.

popupPinHint.message: A PIN has very little entropy and is only safe where guesses are rate-limited. Tick the box below to generate one.
popupPinHint.description: Shown instead of a value on the PIN tab until the acknowledgement box is ticked.

popupPinAck.description: Checkbox the user must tick before a PIN is generated.

popupOptLength.description: Option label: password length in characters.

popupOptLengthSlider.description: Accessible name of the slider that mirrors the password length field.

popupOptCharset.description: Option label: the named set of characters a password is drawn from.

popupOptRequired.description: Group label for the character classes a password must contain.

popupOptExclude.description: Option label: characters that must not appear in the password.

popupOptAllowWeak.description: Checkbox: let the generator produce a password weaker than its minimum entropy.

popupOptWords.description: Option label: number of words in the passphrase.

popupOptSeparator.description: Option label: text between passphrase words, or between an API key's prefix and its random part.

popupOptCapitalize.description: Checkbox: start each passphrase word with a capital letter.

popupOptDigitSuffix.description: Checkbox: add one random digit to the end of the passphrase.

popupOptBytes.description: Option label: number of random bytes in the secret.

popupOptEncoding.description: Option label: text encoding of the secret (base64url, hex and so on).

popupOptPrefix.description: Option label: fixed text placed before a secret or an API key.

popupOptKeyLength.description: Option label: number of random characters after the API key's prefix and separator.

popupOptDigits.description: Option label: number of digits in the PIN.

popupCheckLabel.description: Label of the password input on the Check tab.

popupCheckShow.description: Button: reveal the password typed on the Check tab.

popupCheckHide.description: Button: mask the password typed on the Check tab again.

popupCheckHint.message: Type or paste a password to estimate its entropy. It stays in this popup and is never saved.
popupCheckHint.description: Shown on the Check tab while the input is empty.

popupCheckClasses.description: Character classes found in the checked password. LIST is comma-separated, for example 'Lowercase, Digits'.

popupCheckCaveat.message: This is an upper bound: it assumes every character was chosen at random. Words, names and dates are far weaker.
popupCheckCaveat.description: Caveat under the entropy estimate on the Check tab.

popupShortcutLabel.description: Footer label before the keyboard shortcut that generates a password and fills the focused password field.

popupShortcutUnset.description: Shown after popupShortcutLabel when no keyboard shortcut is assigned.

popupShortcutHintChrome.description: Chrome and Edge: where to assign the shortcut. Keep the address unchanged.

popupShortcutHintFirefox.message: Set it in about:addons: gear menu, Manage Extension Shortcuts.
popupShortcutHintFirefox.description: Firefox: where to assign the shortcut. Keep the address unchanged and use Firefox's own name for the menu item.

popupVersionLabel.description: Footer label before the extension version number.

popupPrivacyNote.message: Runs locally. No network access. Copy leaves the value on your clipboard.
